field: real algebraic coordinates in an isolated rational box
proof: For G(x)=x-AF(x), the exact integer bounds give ||DG||inf<=gamma<1 throughout the rational cube and ||G(c)-c||inf+gamma*r<r. Banach gives a unique fixed point. ||I-AJ(c)||inf<1 makes A invertible, so the fixed point satisfies every one of the72 real moment equations. The parity support makes every omitted moment entry identically zero or Hermitian-conjugate to a checked entry. This proves the full four-dimensional subspace is second-order anticoherent.
